# Bow Down Visuals

> The AI content-creation studio for all creators — YouTubers, streamers, TikTokers, podcasters, and musicians. Make songs, music videos, promo clips, thumbnails, branding, and business assets in one connected workflow (Create → Brand → Promote → Get Paid), paid for in Visual Bucs credits. Home of Thy Cheat Code, the King Shark host.

## Public Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Bow Down Visuals, how it works, the studios, and pricing.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Visual Bucs credit packs ($9–$249) and what each unlocks.
- [Features](/features): Every AI studio and tool, in one searchable list.
- [Explore](/explore): Trending shorts, rising creators, hot posts, events, and groups.
- [Winners' Circle](/winners): Challenge champions and the hall of fame.
- [Charts](/charts): The hottest tracks, videos, and creators right now.
- [Browse](/browse): Browse what creators are making.
- [Genres](/genres): Genre hubs with real facts (BPM, origins, signature sounds) and the AI pipeline for each sound.
- [For Creators](/for): AI toolkits by creator type — YouTubers, podcasters, streamers, musicians, TikTokers, and educators.
- [Academy](/academy): Creator Academy — guides, copyright, LLC, and community playbooks.
- [Monetization Coach](/coach): The Money Room coach — turn content into income, step by step.
- [Tools](/tools): Standalone AI tool pages (song maker, thumbnail maker, hook generator, caption generator, clip maker, music video maker).
- [Templates](/templates): Template galleries for videos, thumbnails, hooks, and captions.
- [Showcase](/showcase): Work made with Bow Down Visuals.
- [Download](/download): Get the Android app and the Chrome extension.
- [Extension](/extension): Thy Cheat Code browser extension — the whole studio in one popup.
- [Beta Access](/beta-access): Request access to the current beta program.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact and support information.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
